title: The glass, no reflection
logline: The reading room's glass door from the hall, and in it, this time, no reflection — the sequence's first page had him in the glass; the last takes him out. The room beyond, the lamp on, the chair empty.

panels.composition: A reading room's glass door from a hallway with no reflection in it, the room beyond with a green lamp lit and an empty chair, metal shelves.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a library reading room's glass door seen from a hallway with no reflection in the glass, the room beyond with a green-shaded lamp lit and an empty chair, metal shelves, no words
image.notes: Compare ro_2022-03-06 (his reflection in the glass).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
